text:
incident-bot: ALERT: meter-processor reported token-shadowbeat anomaly (rate spike + kvcache heartbeats missing) in eu-west; invoice flags may be affected :rotating_light:
neha: seeing the alert, can someone confirm customer-visible symptoms? any overage flags firing?
sam: yes - we started getting automated overage emails for ~12 accounts, looks correlated to the spike window 01:02-01:06 UTC
marta: dd'ing logs now — kvcache connection shows intermittent 504s, emitter ack backlog increasing, replay queue growing
wayne: oncall pairing with marta; i'm paging billing-eng and support to prep comms. lia, can you check refunds/holds?
lia: on it — putting holds on any auto-charge flows for affected accounts, filing ticket with support to triage customer notices
billing-eng: initial recon: token counts upstream are duplicated during the heartbeat gap, dedupe heuristics in tallyer didn't kick because batch id missing. working a hotpatch to ignore dup IDs for 10m window
neha: what's the mitigation plan / ETA? do we need a rollback of last deploy?
marta: not a deploy issue. I'm going to restart the kv-reader pool and flip the backup emitter route to the standby writer. doing restart now: ```kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-reader-eu-west -n metering```
sam: watching logs, replay consumer ack rate improving after restart, backlog dropping from ~120k -> 18k in 3m
billing-eng: deploying hotpatch to tallyer (v2.3.1-hotfix): patch adds id-fallback and a guarded dedupe check. pushing to canary 2 nodes now
lia: support paused outbound billing emails at 01:12 UTC, holding on until we confirm counts stable :thumbsup:
wayne: if hotpatch fails: fallback plan is to freeze rate-based billing calc for the window and run manual reconciliation, ops checklist ready
neha: customer impact: hold in place, support to send templated note if invoices already went out. finance notified. need post-incident reconciliation plan and SLA note
marta: can we get a quick smoke of hotpatch? @billing-eng pls post smoke logs once canary complete
billing-eng: canary looks clean — dedupe rate dropped to baseline, no new duplicate ids. promoting to eu-west pool now
sam: emitter backlog fully drained at 01:28 UTC, no further overage emails observed in monitoring
lia: support will send proactive notice for 10 affected customers with instructions; refunds if charges confirmed after manual review
wayne: handing off to day oncall (neha) for postmortem and clean-up. i'll stay available for escalation.
neha: ack handoff. collecting timestamps and runbooks; will open incident report and include prompt set for regression tests. final status: mitigation applied, customer holds in effect, follow-up recon scheduled + billing rollback window if needed.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (mitigation applied) — please file postmortem and tag #billing for RCA within 48h
